games.description: A short co-op trial with NFEN: task puzzles, a death-induced loading failure, one successful level transition, and another stalled load after the next casualty.
games.title: Acatalepsy

games.description: A co-op run with NFEN and Stu ends at a prison soft lock. Sark later returns alone and discovers a different set of levels, moving through the parking lot, pool switches, and a final lifeboat area.
games.title: Backrooms Rec.

games.description: Two solo visits to PsychoHypnotic’s Christmas horror game. Sark recovers 42 presents, unlocks the reindeer route, survives Santa and snowmen, and returns months later for another normal-difficulty clear.
games.title: Backrooms Santa

games.description: A co-op clear with NFEN. Sark collects notes, solves the security-cabin light code, deciphers letter clues, and works through Level Fun’s organ, sequence, and stolen-present challenges.
games.title: Backrooms: Collision Not Found

games.description: A long co-op journey through the Backrooms with changing groups of friends. Sark progresses from the yellow maze and office to the hotel, caves, pool rooms, party rooms, and final arcade, then returns with NFEN for the new Level 421 route.
games.title: Escape the Backrooms

games.description: A co-op escape-room journey with NFEN and Diction. The archive follows the original rooms, caves, grassrooms, sewers, terror hotel and fun level, including failed attempts and completed returns, then the later pool and train-station update. The differently capitalised checklist categories refer to this same game.
